summary: This component displays a grid of blog series cards. It takes raw series data, enhances it by merging in additional metadata from a data file (like custom titles, descriptions, and images), and renders each series as a PostCard. If no series exist, it shows a friendly empty state message instead.

explanations.26: This sets a fallback image path that will be used if a series doesn't have its own custom image defined.
explanations.28: The function returns JSX.Element, which tells TypeScript this component produces React UI elements.
explanations.31: useMemo caches the enriched series list so we don't recreate it every render unless seriesList actually changes.
explanations.34: We're looking up extra metadata for each series by matching its name against the SERIES_DATA array.
explanations.36: The ?? (nullish coalescing) operator means: use data?.image if it exists, otherwise fall back to DEFAULT_IMAGE.
explanations.40: We prefer the counter value from SERIES_DATA, but if it doesn't exist, we keep the one from the original serie object.
explanations.43: The description field only comes from SERIES_DATA (the generateSeriesList function doesn't create descriptions), so we explicitly set it here.
explanations.51: We check if the enriched array is empty to decide whether to show the grid or a 'no series found' message.
explanations.65: We use serie.permalink as the key because it's a unique identifier for each series, which React needs to efficiently update the list.
